newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: KLASCO HANDLES LESS CARGO IN APRIL.
newsitem.headline: KLASCO HANDLES LESS CARGO IN APRIL.

text.p: The state-run Klaipeda Stevedoring Company (KLASCO), the largest stevedoring firm in Lithuania, said on Monday that it handled 740,000 tonnes of cargo in April compared to 891,000 tonnes in March.
The company's economy director, Algirdas Kateiva, also told Reuters that in April 1996, KLASCO handled 623,000 tonnes of cargo.
"On April 20, we started dredging operations in front of three of our quays, and that slowed things down a bit," he said.
Kateiva added that the company expected to handle around 615,000 tonnes of cargo in May as the dredging work continues.
"There is more cargo coming through the port but we won't be able to increase our operations until the work is completed," he said.
He said that the dredging would take at least six months to complete.
